USING ANOTHER BUSSINESS PERKS. 1520 views Q. In regards to taking pictures of people whether at weddings or at random what is said in the books of hadith and Quran about this? answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 15858 Country: India Title: My father use to take bribe ? I want his sins to be washed off can I take out some part of money as repay of bribe and distribute to poor? (As it is not possible to return it to individuals as I don?t know from whom, how much amount he has taken? Question: My father use to take bribe ? I want his sins to be washed off can I take out some part of money as repay of bribe and distribute to poor? (As it is not possible to return it to individuals as I don?t know from whom, how much amount he has taken? Answer ID: 15858 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1460/1160/L=1430) Have an estimation of the amount that your father might have taken and give the amount gradually in charity to the poor and needy, this shall purge away his sins of bribing in-sha-Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
